title: Legacy program oral tradition of agreement with a third party

tellings.quote: I have learned that it is the oral tradition in the legacy program itself that agreements were struck between the United States and a third party

plain: Inside a long-running secret US government effort known as the legacy program, people are said to pass down a story by word of mouth: that the United States once struck agreements with "a third party". Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, says he learned this is "the oral tradition in the legacy program itself". He leaves the third party unnamed, but if true it would mean the government made a deal with someone or something outside ordinary diplomacy.
